description: This credential earner demonstrates a foundational understanding of cybersecurity concepts, objectives, and practices. This includes cyber threat groups, types of attacks, social engineering, case studies, overall security strategies, cryptography, and common approaches that organizations take to prevent, detect, and respond to cyber attacks.
summary_ja: 脅威・攻撃手法・暗号・リスク管理などサイバーセキュリティ基礎のIBM認定パス。
title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals

description: This credential earner demonstrates knowledge of data analytics concepts, methodologies and applications of data science, and the tools and programming languages used in the data ecosystem. The individual has a conceptual understanding of how to clean, refine, and visualize data using IBM Watson Studio.
summary_ja: データ分析の概念・手法とWatson Studioでの整形・可視化を学ぶIBM認定パス。
title: Data Fundamentals

description: This credential earner demonstrates foundational knowledge of artificial intelligence and its core technologies. The individual can explain AI concepts and capabilities, differentiate human learning from machine learning, describe types of machine learning, and explain how neural networks and deep learning function. The earner can identify forms of AI, consider AI ethics implications, and use AI tools responsibly.
summary_ja: 機械学習・深層学習・AI倫理などAI基礎概念を学ぶIBM認定パス。
title: AI Fundamentals: Foundations for Understanding AI

description: This credential earner has an understanding of core concepts such as AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multiagent systems, with a focus on their application to real-world contexts. The earner will work with simulation-based use cases, including enhancing HR virtual assistants with RAG and automating procurement processes.
summary_ja: AIエージェント・RAG・マルチエージェントの実務応用を学ぶIBM認定パス。
title: Make Agentic AI Work for You
